+def _get_units_from_attrs(var) -> str:
+    """Extracts and formats the "units" attribute value of `var`, if any,
+    for display in the one-line summary used by e.g. ``Dataset.__repr__``.
+
+    Returns an empty string if `var` has no "units" attribute (or does not
+    have an ``attrs`` mapping at all).
+    """
+    units = getattr(var, "attrs", {}).get("units")
+    if units is None:
+        return ""
+    return f", in {units}"
+
